$comment: Which of the tools fernway-accounts proposes the model may be offered, to whom, with the policy's own wording and the server's input schema pinned by the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON. Only this policy emits governance.capabilities (R-15). list_members is granted to Owners and Admins only; a Member's request reports it as capability_not_allowed.

get_account.description: Get the signed-in workspace's plan, billing cycle, seat count and data region. workspace is the signed-in workspace id.

list_members.description: List the signed-in workspace's members with their role and billing-admin flag.

get_service_status.description: Current service status for the workspace's data region, EU or US.
